title: Oharu ThemeV1
description: Safe color tokens, with an optional declaration for approved visual assets. New illustrated themes are pending owner approval; only none/off visuals are currently enabled. OharuThemes.validate additionally enforces WCAG contrast. Imports remain drafts until explicit Apply. No URL, CSS, JavaScript, layout or account fields are accepted.

name.description: The current JavaScript validator also limits the name to 40 UTF-16 code units; astral Unicode symbols use two units.

$comment: Authoritative semantic validation: text/bg, text/card, muted/bg, muted/card, accent/bg, accent/card, accent/soft, danger/card, danger/dangerSoft and #FFFFFF/accent must each have WCAG relative-luminance contrast >=4.5:1. File imports are limited to 8192 bytes; JSON string validation limits the input to 8192 UTF-16 code units. Neither transport limit can be expressed as an object-level standard JSON Schema keyword.
